name: Microsoft Outlook
description: Microsoft 365 email, calendar events and contacts.

objects.label: emails
objects.description: Messages in a mailbox, newest first. Shared mailboxes count if the automation has access.

fields.label: folder
fields.description: A mail folder such as Inbox, Sent Items, Archive, or one you made.

objects.label: calendar events
objects.description: Meetings and appointments on a calendar, including ones the mailbox was invited to.

fields.label: attendee
fields.description: A person invited to the event.

fields.label: location
fields.description: A room, an address, or the online meeting name.

fields.label: online meeting
fields.description: Has a Teams or other online meeting link.

fields.label: response
fields.description: How the calendar owner answered the invitation.

objects.label: contacts
objects.description: People saved in the mailbox's contacts, not the whole company directory.

fields.label: category
fields.description: An Outlook category on the contact, like Vendors or Press.

actions.label: an email
actions.description: Send mail from the mailbox this runs as. Choose whether each item becomes its own message.

params.label: to
params.description: An address, several addresses, or a piece that holds people.

actions.label: a draft
actions.description: Nothing is sent. The draft waits in the mailbox for a person to review and send.

actions.label: a calendar event
actions.description: One event per record. Invitations go out to anyone invited.

params.label: starting at the time in
params.description: The source field that holds the date and time.

params.label: on the calendar
params.description: Leave blank for the mailbox's own calendar.

guidance: Outlook is reached through the Microsoft Graph API, normally as an Entra ID app registration with application permissions limited to specific mailboxes by an application access policy. Shared mailboxes and other people's calendars need their own grant from the tenant administrator; the automation cannot see them just because a person can. Prefer a draft over a send when someone should review first, and send bulk mail from a shared or service mailbox rather than a person's.

setup.notes: Ask the Microsoft 365 administrator to register the app in Entra ID and grant it access to the mailbox or calendar this will run as. Shared mailboxes and room calendars need to be named in that grant.
